description: This file defines the 'WebService' struct and associated methods for building RESTful web services, including route management, parameter definitions, and documentation features.

classes.name: WebService
classes.description: A struct representing a collection of RESTful routes, parameters, and documentation for a web service.

methods.name: SetDynamicRoutes
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic route management.

methods.name: TypeNameHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom function to handle translating object types into documentation strings.

methods.name: compilePathExpression
methods.description: Compiles the root path into a regular expression for routing.

methods.name: ApiVersion
methods.description: Sets the API version for documentation.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the API version.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Sets the root URL path for the WebService.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Adds a path parameter for documentation.

methods.name: PathParameter
methods.description: Creates a new path parameter with default string data type.

methods.name: QueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a new query parameter with default string data type.

methods.name: BodyParameter
methods.description: Creates a new body parameter.

methods.name: HeaderParameter
methods.description: Creates a new header parameter.

methods.name: FormParameter
methods.description: Creates a new form parameter.

methods.name: MultiPartFormParameter
methods.description: Creates a new multipart form parameter.

methods.name: Route
methods.description: Creates and adds a new route using a RouteBuilder.

methods.name: RemoveRoute
methods.description: Removes a route matching the specified path and method if dynamic routes are enabled.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Creates a new RouteBuilder with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: Produces
methods.description: Specifies MIME types that the WebService can produce.

methods.name: Consumes
methods.description: Specifies MIME types that the WebService can consume.

methods.name: Routes
methods.description: Returns the list of routes, copying if dynamic routes are enabled.

methods.name: RootPath
methods.description: Returns the root URL path.

methods.name: PathParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of path parameters.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a filter function to the WebService.

methods.name: Doc
methods.description: Sets the documentation string for the WebService.

methods.name: Documentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation string.

methods.name: HEAD
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a HEAD route.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a GET route.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a POST route.

methods.name: PUT
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a PUT route.

methods.name: PATCH
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a PATCH route.

methods.name: DELETE
methods.description: Shortcut for creating a DELETE route.

methods.name: OPTIONS
methods.description: Shortcut for creating an OPTIONS route.
